label: DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY
not_a_claim: CONFIRMED_LOCAL is a descriptive local effect on a frozen corpus with a SYNTHETIC-vintage close (S34); it is uncharged and not walk-forward, so it is not a scored claim.

corpus.description: data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_tennis.parquet x close_join, 33685 states 2015-01-04..2025-12-17, ATP + WTA kept separate

WTA.reason: the declared trigger column is entirely null in this corpus_unit

rows.note: the mechanism's ingredient is a serve-tier x return-tier PAIRING cell; the scored corpus carries the serve side per player (p1/p2_hold_pct_asof) and the return side as a differential (diff_return_won_asof), so the pairing is rendered at corpus grain as the product of the two as-of differentials -- a declared rendering of the interaction, not a per-player tercile cell

rows.reason: the ingredient is a point-level score state (break / game / set / tiebreak / deuce) from data/cache/sackmann_pbp/slam_points.parquet; data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_tennis.parquet is match-grain and carries no point-state column, and the claim's outcome is a per-point rate, not the p1-win label

rows.note: the mechanism is a surface x serve-advantage interaction; both ingredients are corpus columns, so the trigger is the as-of serve-advantage differential MASKED to clay matches (surface is a native corpus column, 12,191 of 41,886 rows)

rows.reason: the ingredient is per-point serve speed from the charting corpus, compared across an ordinal within-match point split; data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_tennis.parquet holds no point rows and no serve-speed column, and the outcome is a within-match decay, not the p1-win label

the ingredient is a per-point double-fault indicator bucketed by set number; data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_tennis.parquet carries neither a set-number nor a double-fault column. The section's own status is REJECTED; it parses as wired here only because the text contains CONFIRMED_LOCAL

the trigger is player handedness from data/domains/tennis/players.parquet; data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_tennis.parquet carries no hand column, so the right-versus-left contrast cannot be formed at corpus grain

the trigger is matches_last_7d from data/domains/tennis/schedule_density.parquet and the outcome is an in-match retirement; data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_tennis.parquet carries no schedule-density column and its label is the p1-win indicator, not a retirement indicator

the trigger is the realized first-set winner, an in-match state; data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_tennis.parquet holds only pregame as-of columns and no set-level state, so the conditioning event does not exist in it
the ingredient is a point-to-point sequence within a service game from slam_points.parquet; data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_tennis.parquet is match-grain with no point rows and no streak column

the trigger is prior-match duration in minutes; data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_tennis.parquet carries no minutes or prior-match-duration as-of column -- the only load-shaped columns anywhere local are in schedule_density.parquet, which is not joined into the scored corpus

the ingredient is a per-player surface-specific as-of win rate; data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_tennis.parquet carries a native surface column but its as-of player columns (p1/p2_hold_pct_asof, diff_return_won_asof, diff_break_pct_asof) are surface-blind, so no specialization quantity exists at corpus grain and the claim is a split-half persistence property
the ingredient is game-grain deuce length and the outcome is the next game's serve result; data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_tennis.parquet holds neither game rows nor a deuce-length column
the trigger is the tournament round crossed with seeding; data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_tennis.parquet carries neither a round nor a seed column, so the by-round upset contrast cannot be formed

the trigger is round crossed with surface and the outcome is a retirement rate; data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_tennis.parquet carries surface but no round column, and its label is the p1-win indicator rather than a retirement indicator

the trigger is a recency-weighted head-to-head record between the two players; data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_tennis.parquet carries no head-to-head column and no ranking column -- p_elo is a rating built by the walk-forward Elo, a different quantity from the ranking this claim controls for

the trigger is player height from data/domains/tennis/players.parquet (ATP-only); data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_tennis.parquet carries no height column, so the height x surface interaction cannot be formed at corpus grain

the ingredient is a break-point conversion rate bucketed by set number; data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_tennis.parquet carries diff_break_pct_asof as a single pregame differential and no set-number axis, so the by-set contrast this claim rests on does not exist in it
the trigger is the match format (best-of-5 versus best-of-3); data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_tennis.parquet carries no best_of column, and its two corpus_units are tours (ATP / WTA), not formats

the trigger is venue altitude from data/domains/tennis/travel_scouting.parquet (100 percent ATP event_ids) and the outcome is a combined ace rate; data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_tennis.parquet carries neither an altitude nor an ace-rate column
the trigger is travel_diff_1000mi from travel_scouting.parquet; data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_tennis.parquet carries no travel column, so the effect cannot be measured net of ranking at corpus grain

WTA.reason: the declared trigger column is entirely null in this corpus_unit

rows.note: the mechanism's own ingredient is a pregame break-point differential and diff_break_pct_asof is exactly that column at corpus grain, as-of and leak-free

rows.reason: the ingredient is avg_games_per_set_asof_diff from data/domains/tennis/asof_setdetail.parquet; that column is not carried into data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_tennis.parquet, whose as-of family is hold, return and break-point percentages only

the trigger is a within-match cumulative game index mapped to a ball-age cycle and the outcome is ace rate or serve speed; data/cache/combo/gate_corpus_tennis.parquet holds no point or game rows and none of those three quantities
